name: EXM_CARD_EXP_TYPE_MAPS
description: This table contains the mapping between corporate card expense types and expense types in an expense template and the automatic itemization behavior for card expense types.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense template which stores the  corporate card expense type to expense type mapping.

columns.name: CARD_EXPENSE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Expense types used for corporate card transactions processing, such as AIR, HOTEL, and CAR RENTAL.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense type defined in the expense template.

columns.name: AUTOMATIC_ITEMIZATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the corporate card expense should be automatically itemized based on the expense type mapping.

columns.name: AUTO_ITEMIZE_DFLT_EXP_TYPE
columns.description: Default expense type assigned to an itemized corporate card expense when the card expense type of the itemized expense is not mapped to an expense type.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
